description: This file defines a function 'install_projects' that sets up hooks related to project and project task modules within a CRM system. It includes hooks for deleting project tasks and updating project end dates after save events.

methods.name: install_projects
methods.description: Registers hooks for project-related modules to handle events like 'before_delete', 'before_save', and 'after_save' for project and project task modules.
